'''Fussing and Fighting''' (Japanese: '''VS ポカブ''' ''VS Tepig''), titled '''VS Tepig''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 461st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the first chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}.

It is subtitled '''The Night Before''' (Japanese: '''前夜''' ''The Eve'') in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
The chapter opens up to an evening at the Juniper Pokémon Lab in [[Nuvema Town]]. [[Professor Juniper]] is seen talking to someone on the phone about her plan to entrust three Pokémon to three upcoming {{pkmn|Trainer}}s the next day. Before she goes to eat dinner, Professor Juniper decides to put her [[first partner Pokémon]], {{p|Snivy}}, {{p|Oshawott}}, and {{p|Tepig}} into their {{i|Poké Ball}}s. 

Before she can, Professor Juniper is interrupted by a phone call from her friend [[Fennel]]. Tepig notices some food on Professor Juniper's desk and burns one of the {{Berries}} to eat it. While it eats, Tepig accidentally splashes [[Berry Juice]] onto Snivy, angering it. Snivy attacks Tepig and the two get into a fight, worrying Oshawott in the process. Oshawott tries to stop the two from fighting but only gets itself hurt in the process.

Angered, Oshawott goes into a violent frenzy and begins wildly attacking the other two Pokémon, forcing them to defend themselves. Overhearing the commotion, Professor Juniper sees the mess the three Pokémon made and sends them back into their Poké Balls. While she cleans up the mess with her {{p|Minccino}}, Professor Juniper worries if Tepig, Oshawott, and Snivy can become friends with their Trainers.

==Major events==
* [[Professor Juniper]] prepares to give three Pokémon to three upcoming {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. 
* {{TP|Black|Tepig}} and {{TP|Cheren|Snivy}} start a fight, with {{TP|Bianca|Oshawott}} getting pulled into it as well.
* Professor Juniper stops the fight and worries if the three can get along with their Trainers.
